meta.name: Undercover Billionaire
meta.description:
Billionaire Glenn Stearns attempts a monumental challenge that most would claim is impossible. Follow this self-made mogul to see if he can build a million-dollar company in just 90 days.

Returning Series · First aired 6 Aug 2019 · United States of America · Language: English · 45 min

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Million Dollar Bet
videos.overview: Billionaire Glenn Stearns is determined to conceive and grow another million-dollar business from scratch in just 90 days in Erie, Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Start Up Or Die Trying
videos.overview: Billionaire Glenn Stearns hits a breaking point that sends him to the hospital and threatens to shut down his mission to identify a new business and grow it to a $1-million valuation in just 90 days.

videos.title: Take The Bull By The Horns
videos.overview: To fund his new company, Glenn gambles all the money he's earned so far on his biggest money-making scheme yet, but a major roadblock threatens to shut it all down.

videos.title: House Of Cards
videos.overview: Glenn doubles down on his million-dollar idea with a bold new plan to expand the business. But in the midst of making deals, Glenn's confronted with the prospect of losing all of his startup funds, leaving him fighting to keep the dream alive.

videos.title: No Pain, No Gain
videos.overview: With his team depending on him, Glenn loses a critical deal and is sent spinning. As the pressure mounts, the underdogs rally to flip a house that could save the business and change their lives forever.

videos.title: Exposed
videos.overview: The Underdog BBQ team races to prepare for their opening day, but when Glenn accidentally reveals his true identity to a team member, it puts the entire business and the bet in jeopardy.

videos.title: Trial By Fire
videos.overview: Glenn sinks everything into Underdog BBQ's big debut and first chance to make money. But before the cash register even opens, the team's plan goes up in flames, threatening the future of the company before the 90-day deadline.

videos.title: Final Reckoning
videos.overview: Glenn's 90 days are up and it's time to find out if his business is worth a million dollars. But first, Glenn reveals his true identity to his team as well as what each one of them has earned for their part of Underdog BBQ.
